evidence.V1: Front (gem in a gold cup with side prongs), three-quarter and top (octagonal table with 4 prong tips) all read at 64 px; the silhouette is a clear big-gem-over-tapered-cup shape, but the prongs only show as small ears.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big faceted gem, medium tapered collet cup, small 4 prongs plus table/crown facets; no uniform noise.
evidence.V3: Gem is chunky and confident, but the prongs are thin spikes that flare outward off the pavilion (open gaps in the front view) and stop at the girdle without gripping the crown (top view: tips sit outside the girdle), and the collet reads as a plain straight-sided bucket.
evidence.V4: Inconsistent: the collet rim and base have a visible chamfer band and the prongs have small edge chamfers, but the gem's table/crown facet edges are razor-sharp with no thin highlight bevel, and the prong tips are needle points.
evidence.V5: Gem faceting is by design and the shading is clean there, but the round collet shows vertical faceting bands in the studio close-up and front view, and there is a small dark notch/step in the collet rim where the back-right prong base crosses it (setting close-up, studio and flat). Minor artifacts, so capped at 1.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one gem hue in about 3 values (light table, mid crown, near-black pavilion) plus a gold accent; the crimson/shadow colourways hold the same value structure.
evidence.V7: 528 tris vs small-class target 600 (ceiling 1500): at or under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold accent and one hue in 3 values match, but the faceted collet shading and unchamfered gem facet edges differ from the kit's smooth shading and ~0.045-stud chamfers: minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct for a pickup/socket gem: origin bottom-centre, CanCollide off, CanTouch on, CollisionFidelity Box, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Vertical faceting bands on the round collet cup (front view, setting close-up studio)
Small notch/step in the collet rim where the back-right prong base meets it (setting close-up studio and flat, near the right rim)
Prong seating is uneven between pairs: claw0/claw2_on_collet penetrate 0.396 studs vs 0.026 for claw1/claw3 (gate seats), although the X/Y symmetry error is 0
top_fixes: Smooth-shade the collet (more segments or auto-smooth on the round wall) and clean up the rim where the prongs cross it so there is no notch
Make the prongs thicker and curl their tips over the crown edge so they visibly grip the gem instead of flaring out from the pavilion and ending as needle points outside the girdle
Add the kit's ~0.045-stud chamfer to the gem's girdle and table/crown edges so they catch light like the rest of the kit
Seat all four prongs the same way (match the claw1/3 vs claw0/2 penetration into the collet)
Give the collet some shape (a flared lip or a waist) so it reads less like a plain bucket
